original_title: Les arts de gouverner : du regimen médiéval au concept de gouvernement
note: Truncated subtitle; Senellart’s 1995 Seuil monograph. No candidate works supplied.

original_title: Erfarenhet, tid och historia : om historiska tiders semantik
note: Swedish selection translated by Joachim Retzlaff, with an introduction by Helge Jordheim. Publisher specifies five of the fourteen essays in Vergangene Zukunft (1979); neither that complete book nor its English translation is the same selection. Underlying essays are German; this collection first appeared in Swedish.

original_title: I det modernas landskap : historisk orientering och kritiska berättelser om det moderna Sverige mellan 1960 och 1990
note: Published doctoral monograph, Symposion, 2006. Historia som domstol (2012) is a different book.

original_title: Essais sur le politique : XIXe-XXe siècles
note: Portuguese translation by Eliana M. Souza, Paz e Terra, 1991. Matches the French collection; prefer it to the English Democracy and Political Theory.

original_title: Needs of the Heart: A Social and Cultural History of Brazil's Clergy and Seminaries
note: Padres, celibato e conflito social is the Portuguese edition of the 2006 book. The similarly titled 1993 dissertation is its antecedent, not the published book’s original edition; Secret Dialogues is a different work.

original_title: Pour une histoire politique
note: Portuguese edition of the collective volume directed by René Rémond, translated by Dora Rocha; 2003 is its second Brazilian edition. Serge Berstein contributes the chapter on parties, but none of his supplied candidates is this volume.

original_title: Rio Grande do Sul and Brazilian Regionalism, 1882–1930
note: Shortened citation of O regionalismo gaúcho e as origens da revolução de 1930 (Perspectiva, 1975), the Portuguese translation of Love’s Stanford University Press book. Original ISBN confirmed in the university library catalogue.

id: W:motta|introducao a historia dos partidos politicos brasileiros
original_title: Introdução à história dos partidos políticos brasileiros
note: Editora UFMG, 1999, Humanitas pocket, 153 pages. Absent from supplied candidates; Partido e sociedade: a trajetória do MDB is a separate work.

original_title: La dynamique du capitalisme
note: Portuguese translation of the French Arthaud edition (1985). The three lectures also appeared earlier in English as Afterthoughts on Material Civilization and Capitalism (1977; candidate w-94); retain the French original-language record. Distinct from the larger Civilisation matérielle series.

id: W:grimal|dicionario da mitologia grega e romana
original_title: Dictionnaire de la mythologie grecque et romaine
note: Portuguese translation by Victor Jabouille; the cited 2005 printing belongs to Grimal’s dictionary. Prefer the French original to the English dictionary records; the concise dictionary is abridged.

original_title: The Unbound Prometheus: Technological Change and Industrial Development in Western Europe from 1750 to the Present
note: Portuguese translation of Landes’s 1969 book; the cited 1994 Campus edition predates the revised English edition of 2003. The linked publisher record describes the work and its later revision.

original_title: Los Estados Unidos y la América Latina : la construcción de la hegemonía
note: The 2002 Unesp Portuguese edition corresponds to the same book published by Casa de las Américas in Spanish in 2001, winner of that year’s essay prize. Supplied candidate is the Spanish edition; ISBN identifies the cited Portuguese edition.

original_title: Vom Kriege
note: Portuguese translation of Vom Kriege, first issued in 1832–1834. Match the standalone German book record (1937 edition), not w-238436, the broader collected Hinterlassene Werke, or selections from On War.

id: W:paim|historia das ideias filosoficas no brasil
original_title: História das idéias filosóficas no Brasil
note: Paim’s monograph first appeared with Grijalbo/Edusp in 1967. No candidates supplied. The confirmed OCLC is explicitly for the expanded third edition, Convívio/INL, 1984, used as a catalogue locator for the same work; no first-edition identifier was confirmed.

original_title: A formação da elite colonial : Brasil c. 1530–c. 1630
note: Author and “c. 1530-c” fragment most likely indicate Rodrigo Ricupero’s A formação da elite colonial (Alameda, copyright 2008, commonly cited as 2009), candidate w-1187305. However, the title field is only an imprint, and Martins Fontes, 2004 instead fits Bernardo Ricupero’s O romantismo e a idéia de nação no Brasil (1830–1870). Likely conflated references; do not assert a graph match without the full citation.

id: W:le goff|uma historia do corpo na idade media
original_title: Une histoire du corps au Moyen Âge
note: Portuguese translation of the 2003 book coauthored by Jacques Le Goff and Nicolas Truong, published by Civilização Brasileira in 2006. ISBN identifies that Brazilian edition.

id: W:schmitt|os vivos e os mortos na sociedade medieval
original_title: Les revenants : les vivants et les morts dans la société médiévale
note: Portuguese translation, Companhia das Letras, 1999. The Portuguese title translates the French subtitle and drops Les revenants; the publisher-hosted review explicitly explains this. Prefer the French original to Ghosts in the Middle Ages.

original_title: Sex, Dissidence, and Damnation: Minority Groups in the Middle Ages
note: Portuguese translation, Zahar, 1993, with subtitle As minorias na Idade Média. Same work as the 1991 English book; ISBN identifies the cited Brazilian edition.

original_title: Histoire médiévale de la péninsule Ibérique
note: Portuguese translation published by Estampa in 1995. The 1993 Seuil synthesis is absent from supplied candidates; Valladolid au Moyen Age and the edited political-discourse volume are different works.

original_title: The Hero with a Thousand Faces
note: Portuguese translation/reprint of Campbell’s 1949 book. Prefer the original English record to El héroe de las mil caras (1959).
